problems_addressed.specific_problem: Low engagement on real estate-focused social media posts
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Incorporate personal life content to boost engagement and build connection.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Establishing credibility without top rankings or awards

episode_summary: Kim Rittberg discusses the importance of incorporating personal content into social media strategies to boost engagement and build connection. She emphasizes the continued relevance of video content and offers tactics for repurposing long-form videos into short-form clips. The episode also highlights ways to establish credibility through client success stories and leveraging past professional experiences.
